SELECT 
  conversation_id,
  user_message,
  bot_response,
  user_feedback,
  sentiment,
  resolved,
  created_at
FROM chatbot_conversations
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND user_feedback IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;

INSERT INTO chatbot_training_jobs (
  training_id,
  data_quality_score,
  total_examples,
  positive_examples,
  negative_examples,
  avg_user_feedback,
  resolution_rate,
  finetuning_status,
  finetuning_job_id,
  model_name,
  estimated_cost,
  problematic_patterns,
  ai_recommendations,
  training_report,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.training_id }}',
  '{{ $json.training_summary.data_quality_score }}',
  {{ $json.training_summary.total_examples }},
  {{ $json.training_summary.positive_examples }},
  {{ $json.training_summary.negative_examples }},
  {{ $json.training_summary.avg_user_feedback }},
  '{{ $json.training_summary.resolution_rate }}',
  '{{ $json.fine_tuning.status }}',
  '{{ $json.fine_tuning.job_id || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.fine_tuning.model }}',
  '{{ $json.fine_tuning.estimated_cost }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.problematic_patterns) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_analysis) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
